title: No Charging — safe first checks
safe_diagnostic_steps: Inspect the cable and adapter for visible damage; stop using damaged accessories.
Try a known-good, standards-compliant cable and adapter with a different outlet.
With power disconnected, check the port visually under good light; do not insert metal tools.
Restart the phone and observe whether a charging indicator appears.
safety_notes: Unplug before inspection. Do not scrape contacts, use liquids, or charge a wet, swollen, or hot phone. Do not puncture lithium cells, attempt board-level reflow, or bypass carrier/baseband protections.
disclaimer: Illustrative training example only; not a verified issue for this brand or model.

title: No Display — safe first checks
safe_diagnostic_steps: Charge with a known-good accessory for 30 minutes, then try a normal restart.
Check brightness, accessibility, and display settings if the device responds to touch or audio.
Call the phone or connect it to a trusted computer to distinguish a display symptom from a full power failure.
Look for cracks, liquid exposure, or swelling without pressing on the screen.
safety_notes: Do not press on cracked glass or open the device. Suspected liquid damage needs professional assessment. Do not puncture lithium cells, attempt board-level reflow, or bypass carrier/baseband protections.
disclaimer: Illustrative training example only; not a verified issue for this brand or model.

title: Network Issue — safe first checks
safe_diagnostic_steps: Check for a carrier outage and confirm the account has service.
Toggle airplane mode once, then restart the device.
Reseat the SIM only with the device powered off and use the correct eject tool gently.
Test the SIM in another compatible phone, or another known-good SIM in this phone.
safety_notes: Do not bypass carrier locks, alter IMEI/baseband data, or install unofficial radio firmware. Do not puncture lithium cells, attempt board-level reflow, or bypass carrier/baseband protections.
disclaimer: Illustrative training example only; not a verified issue for this brand or model.

title: Boot Loop — safe first checks
safe_diagnostic_steps: Disconnect accessories and use the documented normal restart for the device family.
Charge using a known-good accessory and allow a short cooling period if warm.
If available, use the manufacturer's documented recovery/update process without unlocking or wiping first.
Back up data if the device becomes stable; seek service before factory reset if data matters.
safety_notes: Avoid bootloader unlocks, factory resets, and unofficial firmware when preserving data is important. Do not puncture lithium cells, attempt board-level reflow, or bypass carrier/baseband protections.
disclaimer: Illustrative training example only; not a verified issue for this brand or model.

title: No Sound — safe first checks
safe_diagnostic_steps: Check ringer, media volume, mute, Do Not Disturb, and the selected audio output.
Disconnect Bluetooth devices and test with a locally stored audio clip.
Inspect speaker openings for loose debris; use a soft dry brush only, with no liquid or sharp tools.
Restart and retest a call and media playback separately.
safety_notes: Do not insert pins or liquid into openings; stop if the device has signs of liquid damage. Do not puncture lithium cells, attempt board-level reflow, or bypass carrier/baseband protections.
disclaimer: Illustrative training example only; not a verified issue for this brand or model.

title: Overheating — safe first checks
safe_diagnostic_steps: Stop charging and close demanding apps; move the phone out of direct sun.
Remove a case temporarily and allow the device to cool naturally on a hard surface.
Check battery and app-usage screens after cooling; note whether heat recurs during idle use.
If swelling, odor, smoke, or severe heat is present, stop handling and seek qualified service.
safety_notes: Never puncture, bend, compress, or reflow a battery/device. Do not place it in a freezer or water. Do not puncture lithium cells, attempt board-level reflow, or bypass carrier/baseband protections.
disclaimer: Illustrative training example only; not a verified issue for this brand or model.
